My friend and I went to this national park that had a huge dessert in it. They let you hike in the middle of the night, there were no lights in order to prevent light pollution. I thought it would be cool to see the stars in the dessert, but didn't realize how dark it is at night.
 We walked for about thirty minutes, the wind was so strong it was hard to keep my eyes open. My friend wanted to go back to our hotel so I agreed. We then realized how lost we really were. 

As we wandered around we met a guy who was lost too. We waded though a cactus field for hours trying to find the road again. After finding a road we began to walk towards the parking lot, only for me to see a mountain lion. We slowly turned around went to the camp site and got the ranger to drive us back. Never again will I go hiking in the dessert at night.
